'''Andrew Rice''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Bossier City tournament]] on 4 November 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down dueling]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Jeremy Sumrall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1415">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-bossier-city-la-11-4-00d1415/ bossier-city-la-11-4-00], DeckTech (Jeremy "pakkratt" Sumrall, 5 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-05-bossier-city-la-11-4-00d1415/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
